title: Disposition of collected fines and penalties.
bodyText: Fines and penalties collected under this part shall be deposited into the environmental response revolving fund established by section 128D-2.
bodyHtml: [§342I-35]  Disposition of collected fines and penalties.  Fines and penalties collected under this part shall be deposited into the environmental response revolving fund established by section 128D-2. [L 2000, c 173, pt of §1]
